subject: QBR prep — product/eng status, hardened timelines & top delivery mitigations
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — product/eng status, hardened timelines & top delivery mitigations

Team —

Ahead of next week's QBR I want a short consolidated brief from product and eng that covers:
1) Hardened launch timelines for the three prioritised initiatives (Neptune indexing, Streaming API GA, Optimize autopilot). Call out any changes since the roadmap published last month.
2) Top 3 delivery risks for each initiative and the specific mitigations we will commit to in the 2-week pre-QBR window.
3) Owner-level asks for leadership (escalations, cross-team blockers, capacity trades).

Please attach the latest timeline (use the v3 spreadsheet) and a concise risk matrix (one page). I will forward a summary to Execs on Monday morning; keep your inputs tight — execs want concrete tradeoffs and ask lanes, not status paragraphs.

Deliverable: single-slide exec summary + 1-page risk matrix + updated timeline (v3).
Due: EOD Friday, 2028-03-31 PST.

Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

-- attachment stub: launch_timeline_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet) --

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — product/eng status, hardened timelines & top delivery mitigations

Irene — thanks. Quick readout from my side (high level):

Neptune indexing: timeline unchanged for internal GA on 2028-05-15 but external GA slipping ~2 weeks if we keep current infra queueing. Action: double down on the hotfix for KV cache race (owner: Karthik) and add one-week burst capacity from Dedicated pool during rollout (ask to Ops).

Streaming API GA: we are on track for 2028-04-28 for limited GA; outstanding risk is 99th percentile tail for long-lived streams under burst. Mitigation: progressive canary with synthetic traffic and circuit-breaker flags (owner: Marissa).

Optimize autopilot: blocker is model-serving regression from quantization build; mitigation is staged rollback plan + parallel variant testing.

I will collate the one-pagers and updated timeline by EOD Friday. Tagging owners below for the risk matrix and owners' commitments.

Vivek
SVP, Engineering

-- On Thu, Mar 29, 2028 at 09:12, Irene Choi wrote: "Team — Ahead of next week's QBR..."

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — product/eng status, hardened timelines & top delivery mitigations

Irene / Vivek —

Quick status and concrete asks for Neptune KV race fix:
- Root cause confirmed: concurrent write path occasionally evicts warm pages under heavy prefix caching.
- Mitigation plan: add lightweight backpressure in the write path + one extra unit test harness for prefix-heavy workloads.
- Owner: Karthik (engineering) + SRE (to provision a small-scale Dedicated burst pool for rollout).
- Risk window: 2028-04-04 -> 2028-04-18 while we land and canary the fix.

Ask for leadership: approve short-lived Dedicated burst (2 x A100 equivalents) for a two-week window during rollout and permission to postpone external GA by up to two weeks if telemetry shows regression post-canary. I'll add this to the risk matrix.

Karthik
Director, Distributed Systems

We'll run a canary and provide a short test plan; will you confirm willingness to participate?

All — attached the trimmed slide deck for execs (single-slide summary) and the updated timeline (v3). I've called out the mitigations and the exact owner commitments on slide bullets. Highlights:
- Neptune: short Dedicated burst approved by Ops for canary; Karthik to run canary from 2028-04-04.
- Streaming API: canary plan ready; Acme confirmed participation pending DocuSign; Marissa to run synthetic long-stream test 2028-04-10.
- Optimize autopilot: rolling to variant testing on 2028-04-12; rollback gate in place.

Next steps: Irene, if you're good with the slide, I will post to the QBR Confluence and prep the Exec mail for Monday.

Marissa
